sources.snippet: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-Labs-Dory1.0-4B-BF16 converted to the LiteRT-LM (.litertlm) format for Google's LiteRT-LM runtime: an int4 file for the GPU and an int8 file for the CPU, plus a one-loop int4 file: the int4 file's weights in a graph that runs the shared block of layers once per token instead of twice (faster on the GPU, lower on GSM8K; Loops).
